findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 1
Raise: Not done. Case: normal use - Codex reaches capacity during a story's cold read. Done-when 4 includes "a Codex capacity retry until its retry time". src/forge/codex.py:590–604 records cold reads as kind `read`, and its retry branch records their `retry_at`. This helper inspects only `work`/`worker` runs, so it instead reports that the cold reader is running throughout the capacity wait. Inspect the active reader's progress too; the capacity proof currently exercises only `forge work`.

findings.body:
Gain 2, Work 2, Harm 1
Case: normal use - a session-held cold read is stopped and restarted before returning notes. The displayed number comes from the last completed notes plus one. However, src/forge/native.py:107–109 advances the replacement beyond the previous handout, while cancellation at lines 188–198 leaves the completed notes unchanged. Consequently, the wait line names the cancelled round while the adjacent handback command names the replacement. The existing lifecycle test demonstrates this replacement at tests/test_tools_session_hold.py:257–267 but checks the wait line only before restarting. Use the pending round's recorded number.
